# .github/workflows/

Auto-deploy folder. Push to main → auto-publish to GitHub Pages. No manual steps.

---

## What happens

Push to `master` → GitHub runs `deploy.yml`. Publishes `frontend/` to `https://iamvishalsehgal.github.io/Planty`.

~1 min. Watch under **Actions** tab.
